sentences: For the supported `image_sample*_o` forms, the first address VGPR retains the signed texel-offset fields.
The following coordinates and any trailing LOD use packed binary16 halves, low half first.
LLVM counts extra operands as whole words before packing coordinates and LOD ([getAddrSizeMIMGOp](https://llvm.org/docs/doxygen/AMDGPUBaseInfo_8cpp_source.html#l00342)).
On RTX 5080 and Radeon Graphics, `ps_texoff.asm` checked 64 distinct offsets applied to packed U/V at texel (3,5) against the expected texel for each of 4096 pixels.
Swapping the halves or dropping the offset changed 4032 pixels per GPU.
